verification_targets.description: Overall X extent of the L-bracket (base plate length).
verification_targets.notes: Base plate extends from X=-30 to X=+30.

verification_targets.description: Overall Y extent of the L-bracket (width).
verification_targets.notes: Both base and vertical plates are 40mm wide.

verification_targets.description: Overall Z extent of the L-bracket (height from base bottom to vertical top).
verification_targets.notes: Vertical plate rises from Z=0 to Z=30.

verification_targets.description: Base plate, vertical plate and hole subtraction MUST result in a single connected solid.
verification_targets.notes: Union of base and vertical plate must produce exactly one solid; the hole cut must not sever the part.

verification_targets.description: Final exported STEP/mesh MUST be a closed watertight manifold (no open shells, no self-intersections).
verification_targets.notes: Failed run reported 'watertightness violation'. Likely causes: hole cylinder penetrating flush/tangent to a face, hole fully cutting through a thin wall, or overlapping/coincident faces from the union. Extend hole depth beyond both faces to guarantee clean through-cut, and verify the vertical plate thickness (5mm) exceeds the hole diameter (10mm) is satisfiable -- otherwise the hole severs the vertical plate.

functional_requirements: Provide an L-shaped right-angle bracket joining a horizontal base plate to a vertical plate.
Provide a through-hole in the bracket for fastening/clearance (diameter 10mm per Cylinder radius=5).
The finished part must be a single, watertight, manufacturable solid.
special_features: The hole MUST fully penetrate the intended wall(s) with the cylinder extended beyond both outer faces so the cut produces clean open rims, NOT a co-planar/flush face that leaves a non-manifold shell.
The hole subtraction MUST NOT sever the part into multiple bodies -- if HOLE_DIAMETER exceeds the wall it pierces, the remaining geometry MUST stay a single connected solid.

The union of base plate and vertical plate MUST be performed with a robust boolean (e.g. build123d union) so no coincident/overlapping internal faces remain; all internal faces MUST be dissolved into one manifold shell.
All features MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y coordinates mirror about Y=0), since both plates are 40mm wide and the hole is centered on Y.
The vertical plate MUST sit at the X=-VERTICAL_MAX_X end of the base plate and share a full flush contact face with the base so the boolean union is watertight.


Reconstruct the step states from this trace and identify which steps are candidates for causing the watertightness violation.

sketches.notes: Base plate footprint: 60mm along X (world X = -30..+30) by 40mm along Y (world Y = -20..+20), centered on the origin, symmetric about the XZ plane (Y mirrors about Y=0).

Rectangular vertical plate profile on the XZ plane. Local x maps to world X, local y maps to world Z. Rectangle 5mm (X) x 30mm (Z) centered at local (-27.5, 15.0) => spans world X = -30..-25 and world Z = 0..30. The profile reaches Z=0 so it overlaps the base plate volume (Z=0..5) over the full 5mm wall thickness for a robust union; it is not a face-on-face contact. Workplane offset -20 places the sketch at Y=+20 and the 40mm extrusion spans world Y = -20..+20, symmetric about the XZ plane.

steps.label: Extrude base plate 60 x 40 x 5 mm
steps.notes: Base plate solid spans world X = -30..+30, Y = -20..+20, Z = 0..5 (volume 60*40*5 = 12000 mm^3).

steps.label: Extrude vertical plate 5 x 40 x 30 mm at X = -30..-25
steps.notes: Vertical plate solid spans world X = -30..-25, Y = -20..+20, Z = 0..30 (volume 5*40*30 = 6000 mm^3). It shares the full 5mm x 40mm overlap volume (X = -30..-25, Y = -20..+20, Z = 0..5 = 1000 mm^3) with the base plate, so the subsequent boolean union has real volumetric overlap and dissolves all internal faces into one manifold shell.

steps.label: Fuse base plate and vertical plate into a single manifold solid
steps.notes: Robust build123d fuse (boolean union) of the two overlapping solids. The overlap is a true 1000 mm^3 volume, so no coincident/co-planar internal faces remain and the result must be exactly one connected solid (expected volume 12000 + 6000 - 1000 = 17000 mm^3, single-body count == 1). The L-shape outer bounds are X = -30..+30, Y = -20..+20, Z = 0..30.

steps.label: Cut dia 10 mm through-hole in base plate at X=0, Y=0
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z through the 5mm base plate only (base spans Z = 0..5). hole_position is the axis midpoint on the base plate mid-plane (X=0, Y=0, Z=2.5). Cylinder height 10mm is centered on that point, so it spans Z = -2.5..+7.5 and overshoots both outer faces by 2.5mm (>1mm) to guarantee clean open rims with no flush/co-planar face at Z=0 or Z=5. The hole axis is at X=0, far from the vertical plate (X = -30..-25), and the base plate is 60mm long x 40mm wide, so removing dia 10mm leaves a well-connected single solid (no severing into multiple bodies). Removed volume = pi*5^2*5 = 392.7 mm^3 -> final volume 17000 - 392.7 = 16607.3 mm^3.
